update_message:
What's New:

🔧 Audio Engine Fixes
• Fixed crossfade duration not working (was stuck at ~5 sec)
• Crossfade now properly uses your selected 1-12 second duration
• Audio settings now correctly connected to playback engine
• Settings changes apply immediately without restart

🎛️ Supreme Settings Improvements
• Audio Settings tab now uses correct service backend
• Crossfade, Gapless, ReplayGain all properly functional
• Added Fade on Pause/Seek toggle options
• Added Crossfade on Skip toggle option
• Fixed ReplayGain mode selector

📱 UI Fixes
• Fixed update complete popup overflow on long changelogs
• Changelog now scrollable with max height constraint
• Better layout for What's New dialog

🐛 Compiler & Bug Fixes
• Fixed FlacMetadata ambiguous import conflict
• Fixed ThemeCustomizationService.current → .settings
• Fixed gradientPreset → playerGradientPreset
• Added description getter to TabBackgroundStyle
• Fixed ReplayGainModeOption.auto → smart enum
• All audio settings persist and reload correctly
